svg.title: Roof rake edge, layer by layer
svg.desc: A cutaway of the corner where the eave meets the sloped side edge (the rake). At the rake the order is the reverse of the eave: the underlayment runs out to the edge of the deck first, and the metal drip edge goes on top of it, turned down over the rake board. A starter strip runs up the rake over the drip edge, and the shingles finish flush over it. Illustration, not a photo of an actual job. Layer thicknesses are exaggerated so each one can be seen.
svg.text: At the rake the order flips.
